prototype_assumptions: Only the selected care option consumes the preview budget; alternatives are not additive.
Money is converted into complete care days or complete visits. Any remainder carries forward to the next projected monthly gift.
Food is planned in cohorts with at most ten days per dog per monthly gift; veterinary care and rehabilitation uses two-day cohorts. Recipient counts and matching are illustrative.
Food and rehabilitation repeat for the same cohort each month instead of claiming new unique recipients every month.
Each examination/vaccination equivalent uses a different illustrative recipient; unknown future recipients have no invented real profile.

One day of care per recipient is scheduled per day from each projected contribution date; examinations occur on the projected funding date. This is not a clinical schedule or actual shelter reporting.
Monthly contributions start on the plan date and repeat on the same calendar day, clamped to the end of shorter months. The timeline covers twelve contributions at most.
The profile and optional monthly plan are device-local. Forecasts never create actual payments, future donation receipts, or verified care events.
